{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vertical Swoop''' was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] tactic devised by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tomax Bren/Legends|Tomax Bren]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scimitar assault wing]]. It was first employed during the [[Assault of the Aturi Cluster|assault]] against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] position in the [[Aturi Cluster/Legends|Aturi Cluster]].
